conviction_note: Median reaction is 11.35% on 4-up-of-8 with 89% realised vol, and the corpus's two checkable facts - the July equity raise completed at $21 versus a $17.08 spot, and a director's open-market purchase at $18.75 that nobody noticed for six weeks - both cut against a 24% twenty-day slide, so a small positive tilt with a band that keeps the fat tails on both sides.

findings.finding: Director Homer John Livingston III bought 26,343 shares in the open market at $18.75 on 2026-07-16 - one of three Form 4s filed that evening - and the corpus shows the market did not register it until a retail post on 2026-08-29, six weeks later, by which time the stock was 9% below his purchase price and the company had raised equity at $21 on the 424B5s of 2026-07-07 and 2026-07-08, leaving both the insider and the placement book underwater at the $17.08 pre-print close.
findings.why_not_priced: The Form 4 sat unremarked for six weeks in a corpus that is otherwise saturated with retail attention - 175 captured items, five stored bodies, hundreds of messages - which is direct evidence of non-transmission rather than an assumption about it. The consequence the market has not drawn is a balance-sheet one: the company completed its financing in July, so the cash-runway question that has driven this name's prints is off the table for this one, and the stock is nonetheless 24.09% lower over twenty sessions with no company filing since 2026-07-21 and no news item in the capture. The signed direction is modest and the band wide because the corpus is equally clear about the bear case: the only order on the books is a 30 MW deposit from a newly formed counterparty (FIT Energy), there is no binding Tier-1 data-centre off-take, an S-3ASR shelf remains effective so a further raise is available, and the retail base is openly capitulating.
findings.independence: A separate corpus item points the same way on flow rather than insiders: a reported 114,000-share after-hours block worth about $1,975,000 on 2026-08-31, in docs/72990000fa4f53ff2e17acbdc0a606e7df0a9bc8.txt (message of 2026-09-01T03:44:10Z). It is retail-reported and unverifiable, which is why it is corroboration and not the finding. Pulling the other way, from a third source: https://www.merlintrader.com/fuelcell-energy-stock-hub/ (2026-08-31) frames the quarter as the 'Siemens and the AI data center pivot' with no contract to show.

searched_and_found_nothing: any company filing in August 2026: the only August entries in filings.json are a SCHEDULE 13G on 2026-08-04 and a 13G/A on 2026-08-14, both passive-ownership, so the six weeks before the print contain no 8-K, no prospectus supplement and no Form 4

a new contract or off-take announcement: the last item 1.01 8-Ks are 2026-06-24 (bundled with an item 3.02 unregistered sale) and 2026-07-09, both with no stored body, and the corpus's own bear thread is precisely that no binding contract has arrived since
the size of any remaining ATM capacity under the June S-3ASR - not recoverable from the index
a consensus EPS or revenue figure: the only preview in the capture is a Substack link and a Zacks teaser, neither with a stored body
verification of the retail claim of 12m warrants struck at $26.44 and 12m at $21 - no prospectus body is stored, so I could not confirm the warrant overhang or its strike
any short-interest datapoint from a primary source, despite heavy retail claims of short pressure
baseline_tension: It cuts against the run-up: the tape fell 11.5% in five days and 24.1% in twenty, and the finding is that the two hard facts in the window - completed financing and an insider buying above the current price - point the other way. It is consistent with the reaction history's shape, where the four up-moves averaged about +18% and the four down-moves about -8%.
corpus_limits: This is a bmo print, so per the sweep rule I excluded the final snapshot snapshots/20260902T150734Z.json (started 2026-09-02T15:07:34Z, after the item 2.02 8-K was accepted at 07:35:14Z) and its stored body docs/1f2892ca13f52529d1ede6c792c3100b8185880b.txt, which I did not open.
